props.author: Wild_Randomness
props.text: Yes, that's a good point. Definitely harder to play for downside as the bear progresses. There hasn't been a bottoming event yet. Maybe we don't need one, but we're still 4 months early and have drawn down 53% from the highs (previous cycles were 77% and 84%). If we keep -84/-77/-53 pattern, -70 (2026) would imply high 30Ks.
